findings.title: Frame-center extent is incorrectly treated as waveform/segment end
source_facts: features.extract stores waveform duration len(y)/sr separately from its STFT frame_times.
The structure producer writes metadata duration_s=feats.frame_times[-1] and N=round(duration_s*40). It assigns saved roles on t=k/40.

Its segment producer ends the final segment at feats.duration_s, not frame_times[-1]. For the normal centered HOP512/SR22050 grid the final center can precede waveform end by almost one hop, about23.22ms.

The preparer currently requires every segment end <= metadata duration_s+0.0001s. This can reject correctly produced terminal segments and records MATERIAL_QUALIFICATION_FAILED. No real record was opened to measure its frequency.
narrow_fix: Publish a new prospective version; do not edit V3 or relax bounds after reading outputs.

Name three separate quantities: cached frame-center extent L from structure metadata, available sampled role support k=0..N-1 at k/40, and waveform/terminal-segment endpoint D. Keep N=round(L*40), the original arrays, target indices and donor offset0 unchanged. N/40 is a rounded grid stop, not proof of waveform duration.

Validate the producer-consistent terminal-end relationship separately. Prefer the matching already-approved AudioBus waveform duration when same-recording producer provenance is established; audio.online computes len(y)/sr. If that provenance is unavailable, state the weaker terminal-metadata consistency claim rather than inventing waveform truth.

Any exception for an end beyond L must be terminal-only and justified by the frozen producer clock relation, not a blanket enlargement for arbitrary segments. Keep internal segment ordering/nonoverlap/known roles and cache-role agreement checks. Reject endpoints beyond the derived producer bound or inconsistent with the qualified waveform endpoint.

Never clamp/rewrite saved segment bounds, extend the role cache to D, change T, resample, synthesize labels or count missing samples as valid. Missing/gapped role support remains invalid255 and recorded.
required_synthetic_cases: Construct hypothetical sample counts with an exact hop-aligned endpoint and with a nonzero residual inside the final512-sample hop. Derive L,D,N and saved roles as the producer does; do not simply declare duration=end.
Cover both upward/downward round(L*40), including the half-frame convention, without changing valid sample indices.

Correct final segment end at D>L must be accepted under the new explicit schema; an internal segment overrun, overlap, wrong role assignment and an endpoint beyond the producer-consistent boundary must still fail.
Preserve missing/tail/gap support behavior and95%/80-frame prospective rules; do not infer any actual eligible count from these fixtures.

Until that guard exists, root must separately reject any command/environment mismatch before issuing preparation authority. An exact passed source-bound log is not permission to silently change the recorded command.

findings.title: Endpoint-defining producer sources are absent from preparation source_refs
source_facts: V3 binds build_justdance_structure.py, online.py and motion/io.py, but not audio/features.py or audio/structure.py.
These two omitted files define the distinct duration and segment-end semantics used to judge compatibility. The preparer itself does not import them or any project model.
narrow_fix: Add exact hashes of audio/features.py and audio/structure.py as frozen schema-evidence dependencies in the revised source binding. This adds no payload read, feature regeneration, project import or model authority.
